deck.name: planeswalkers
deck.summary:
Jace, Multiverse Architect leads a patient planeswalker deck supported by mana rocks, draw spells, removal, and Reality Fracture's reimagined legends. Develop your mana, establish several planeswalkers, and use the supporting creature package to maintain a board while your threats accumulate. The dedicated finishers, chief among them Jace, Reality Sculptor, give the deck ways to close a longer game. It favors thematic variety and gradual development over fast mana, repeated tutoring, or compact combo plans, but its four-color costs and larger threats can make early turns deliberate. For three buy-list priorities, start with Jace, Reality Sculptor, The Theorist, Jace Beleren, and Chandra, Chill of Compliance.

The quality model grades this deck below the precon baseline against the top lists of the format: few of the cards are ones the top lists of the format play, and that lowers the grade. Many of the cards appear in no top list, and that lowers the grade. The cards pair in ways the top lists do not, and that lowers the grade.
